issues.justification: 'Не актуально' means 'not relevant/topical' and is a dismissal of the idea; 'out of fashion' shifts the meaning, and the irony of the line is weakened.

issues.source_quote: Чтоб ты исдох! Чтоб я видел тебя у гробу, у белых тапках! Чтоб ты жил на одну зарплату!
issues.translation_quote: Drop dead! May I see you in a coffin, wearing white slippers! May you have to live on your salary alone!
issues.justification: The Odessan/Yiddish-inflected non-standard speech of the curse (исдох, у гробу, у белых тапках) is rendered in neutral standard English, losing the colorful character voice.

issues.source_quote: Кто возьмёт билетов пачку, тот получит... Водокачку!
issues.translation_quote: Buy a whole sheaf of tickets and win... a pumping station!
issues.justification: The rhyme (пачку/водокачку) and comic mock-slogan are lost; no rhyming equivalent is attempted.

issues.source_quote: Нет, на это я пойтить не могу!
issues.translation_quote: No, I can't go along with that!
issues.justification: The deliberately comic non-standard 'пойтить' (Gorbunkov's feigned naivety) is not reflected.
